verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills plugin that runs inside a host coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin or Hermes. It lets the user hand off work after an approved plan. The agent dispatches subagents per task, reviews their output with a bundled code-reviewer agent, and can run autonomously for hours. Community users confirm the subagent review loop is useful. The caveat is that the AI is not built into Superpowers itself: delegation depends on a separately installed host agent harness, and every path stops for human approval before implementation. Missing for 10: a self-contained built-in assistant independent of a host harness, and independent hands-on corroboration of long autonomous delegation runs.
